# Meeting room booking: requirements

## 1. Purpose

Move room bookings from the paper ledger to a system, so that anyone can see which rooms are free.

## 2. Functional requirements

### 2.1 Booking

A user can book a room in blocks of thirty minutes. The same room cannot be booked twice for the same time.

### 2.2 Cancelling

A user can cancel their own booking until it starts.

### 2.3 Reminders

The system emails each user the evening before their booking.

## 3. Non-functional requirements

### 3.1 Speed

The booking screen appears within three seconds.

### 3.2 Availability

The system runs without a break from 8:00 to 20:00 on weekdays. Planned maintenance is announced a week ahead through the reminders in Section 2.3.
